messages:
maya: FYI -- after the egress tighten in eu-west-3 last night ~40% of GPU nodes are stuck in BOOTSTRAP with KMS decrypt failures. seeing `decrypt: AccessDenied` in node logs.
rahul: ugh. confirm this is the new default-deny fw rule + privnet keystore change? any correlation with auditshipper traffic?
aisling: we rolled the fw ACL at 23:10, and a KMS policy change landed at 23:02 (grant narrowing). logs show node-init hitting keystore over privatelink then falling back -> fail.
maya: sample log snippet: ```
2026-03-22T23:21:12Z node-702 bootstrap: kms.Decrypt failed: AccessDenied for key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-3:...:key/xxxx
2026-03-22T23:21:12Z node-702 bootstrap: unable to unwrap image secret, aborting join
```
angelo: is the audit shipper outbound to our siem on port 443 being blocked? that would also touch natgw/privatelink and could explain why keystore grant validation failed if callouts can't reach sts/kms.
rahul: checked flow logs: SSL to siem (10.20.30.40:443) is hitting deny on the new egress policy from the gpu-subnet. same rule also blocks privatelink to keystore endpoint.
aisling: can we make a temporary exception for privatelink and the KMS endpoint while we triage? we should avoid full rollback.
maya: +1. customer-facing capacity is impacted (prewarmed pools). estimate 25% reduction in available slots. ops: we should open a P1 and throttle new job scheduling.
sre-bot: incident created INC-20260322-2315, paging oncall SRE. added timeline and first-attached logs.
angelo: quick mitigation: add egress allow for the keystore privatelink CIDR + siem host, and add a narrow NAT rule for sts/kms. I can push an infra patch if eng-sre approves.
rahul: approved. but also flagging cost: audit shipper traffic to siem is high; if we open long-lived allow we might increase cross-region egress bill. propose short TTL whitelists + monitoring.
aisling: agreed. plan: 1) allowlist privatelink and siem IPs (10m emergency window), 2) enable ephemeral KMS-grant fallback for node bootstrap (10m config), 3) monitor decrypt errors and pool join rate, 4) schedule proper fw rule tweak and playbook update.
maya: executing step 1 now. tagging infra to push change. will report join rate in 5m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
angelo: patch merged to firewall canary, pushing to eu-west-3.
sre-bot: rollout: fw-canary eu-west-3 succeeded at 23:33 UTC.
maya: join rate improving, decrypt errors dropping. still seeing some delayed warmup. keeping incident open until stabilization and audit cost delta assessed.
rahul: I'll spin up a quick audit: expected egress increase while allowlist active, estimate +0.6TB/day -> ~€120/day. will update INC ticket.
aisling: we'll bake a narrower rule next sprint to avoid this. also adding kube node bootstrap test to staging for fw-default-deny.
maya: thanks team. followups: add playbook note about coupling keystore privatelink + auditshipper, and prefer explicit nat exceptions over blanket allowlist.
angelo: noted. closing this message thread when incident is resolved. :white_check_mark:
